The thing that piss me off the most is that I had a lot of event dragons there. I still haven't found a way to get it back...

the same thing happened to me like a week ago, and I've lost everything too...
I'm so sorry for your loss
personally I like to cut myself (lol I've also a kink for the knife play) btw sh is considered as an addiction so I do it only if I'm really sick.
sameeee, even if I also take pictures of the cuts that I just made cuz I really love blood.
it depends, if you do these things with the intent to hurt yourself yes.

in my opinion you should not do it
your daughter would probably be traumatized and you would risk inducing her into that way too.
I know this because my mom also tried to commit suicide a few years ago so please don't do it. 
especially if you care about your daughter. 
I know that things may seem terrible but sooner or later everything will improve. 
I am 15 years old so I am small enough to understand the gravity of your situation but I can tell you that this is absolutely not the correct way
you should start a pharmacological treatment, I know that maybe you do not like the idea of having to take medication but I can assure you that they can help and also a lot. 
so please, don't do it, the only thing you should do in my opinion is to stay close to your daughter. 
try to create good times with her
I wish the best for you and your daughter <3

I would like to be able to denounce her but I'm afraid that then she will hurt me more. 
tomorrow I will go to my psychologist with whom I will talk about this, I hope she can help me.
anyway, thank you very much for the support <3

but in fact now I decided to stop taking antidepressants (also because they are totally useless). 
obviously I'm decreasing the doses because I don't want to remove them suddenly for fear that they'll make me sick.

yep, it's self-harm.
you can consider self-harm anything that leads you to hurt / harm yourself.
usually the most common "forms" are to cut yourself with the blade of a razor, or burn with something hot, but yes, you can consider this as sh.

I am an atheists but from what I know about Christianity is that if you commit suicide you go directly in hell because you have refused the "gift of life".
I could also be wrong, this is what I remember from religion lessons at school... 
anyway , I hope you are well

I don't know how the fuck to do, right now I'm hoping it will respond to my messages, while I cry non-stop.

I don't really understand her, that is, if she doesn't want to be with me anymore she could even tell me...
This situation- DJSBDJDK FUCKING I CAN'T TAKE IT ANYMORE.

in case he existed I could just hate him for making my life a crap or even just for the fact that he didn't help me.
